messages:
Maya: dropped a micro-mock for compact tool-call cards in run history — trying a 2-line mini preview + tiny action buttons. screenshot: https://figma.redwood/mock123 :eyes:
Kevin: nice. main concerns: keyboard focus order, and a clear SR label for the preview card. :thumbsup:
Jin: agree. suggest voiceover reads 'Tool call: <name>, preview, N fields' and then each field when focused. also group with role=list/listitem so arrow keys work predictably.
Maya: thinking copy for header: 'translate_text · 132ms' or 'translate_text — 132ms'? which reads nicer?
Sam: prefer the bullet style 'translate_text · 132ms' — more compact. for empty args show 'no args provided' instead of 'no params' (clearer).
Maya: quick question: should hover reveal the full function signature or only a 'View full output' action?
Kevin: make the primary tiny action 'View full output' (action-oriented) and a secondary 'Copy signature' on hover.
Jin: accessibility nit: the 'View full output' button should have aria-expanded when it toggles the inline schema panel. When collapsed the card still needs a semantic summary accessible.
Maya: note on truncation — if we use 'translate_text · 132ms' we might cut off long tool names. propose ellipsize but show full name in tooltip + SR text.
Sam: +1. Also icon for examples? I added a :page_facing_up: small badge when a function has example inputs. shows in header to reduce click cost.
Maya: added a tiny JSON preview in the mock: ```json
{"name": "translate_text", "params": {"text": "Hola mundo","target_lang": "en"}}
```
Kevin: preview layout idea: line1 = first field/value (truncate after ~50 chars), line2 = meta row (type, size, ms). keyboard: tab lands on the card frame, Enter expands, arrows move between cards.
Jin: voiceover flow: "Tool call, translate_text, preview collapsed, two fields" then when focus moves to first field read "text, string, 'Hola mundo'..." Keep reads brief. Also increase header contrast to hit 4.5:1 (current is ~3:1).
Maya: ok will bump header to darker and try 700 weight. run history row height — ops asked for compact (44px) but metrics wanted readability (56px). I'm proposing 52px compromise.
Sam: 52px sounds reasonable, test with long names + keyboard outlines. Also ensure focus ring thickness and color are visible at small sizes.
Kevin: small microcopy nudge: button that expands inline schema — label 'View full output' vs 'Expand schema' — stick with 'View full output' (clearer to non-devs).
Maya: agree. final ask: any objections to showing 'Copy signature' as secondary action (clipboard icon) visible on hover only?
Jin: fine as long as there's a keyboard-accessible control too (not hover-only).
Sam: yep — have a hidden focusable element that becomes visible on keyboard focus.
figma-bot: Updated file uploaded: https://figma.redwood/mock123 (version 3)
Maya: thanks all — I'll iterate and drop updated PNGs here tomorrow. :party-parrot:
